Updated script (so the uppercased names would work): named it "dead-or-alive" and "chmod +x" it:

#!/bin/bash

mydir=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp/}$(basename $0).XXXXXXXXXXXX")
first=$(echo $1 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
last=$(echo $2 | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
lynx -dump https://deadorkicking.com/$first-$last-dead-or-alive/ > $mydir/page
alive=$(cat $mydir/page | grep -i "is alive")
dead=$(cat $mydir/page | grep -i "passed away on")
rc=-1
if [ "$alive" != "" ]
then
 echo $1 $2 is alive.
 rc=0
elif [ "$dead" != "" ]
then
 echo $1 $2 is dead.
 rc=1
else
 echo $1 $2 not found.
fi
exit $rc
